reasons.balanced: Your take sounds balanced, so Polish stays close to our usual settings.
reasons.noisyRoom: Some room noise between lines, so a bit more noise reduction.
reasons.quietRoom: A quiet room, so less noise reduction. Your breaths stay natural.
reasons.hum: A little hum in the room, so a little less low end.
reasons.wideRange: Your voice moves between soft and strong, so a bit more evenness.
reasons.steadyVoice: Your singing is already even, so a little less evenness.
reasons.sharpS: Bright “s” sounds, so a bit more smoothness.
reasons.softS: Gentle “s” sounds, so a little less smoothness.
reasons.thinVoice: A light voice, so a bit more warmth.
reasons.fullVoice: A warm, close voice, so a little less warmth.
reasons.dull: A soft top end, so a bit more clarity.
reasons.bright: Already bright and clear, so a little less clarity.

smoothness.label: Evenness
smoothness.hint: Evens out loud and soft moments

space.label: Space

tuning.label: Tuning
tuning.hint: Pulls notes into the song's key

paramHints.warmthDb: Boosts or cuts the body of the voice

paramHints.tuneStrength: How far notes move to the key
